caption: The drawing, rendered in shades of gray and black on a light beige background, depicts an ornate wrought-iron gate or panel design. It is rectangular with a decorative arched and elaborately detailed top featuring swirling floral motifs, scrollwork, and a central arrangement reminiscent of a flower bouquet. Within the main rectangle, the central feature is a figure of a cherub or putto holding a bow, positioned amidst dense foliage consisting of curling vine shapes and leaves, which frame and surround the figure. On both sides of the figure, vertical columns rise, decorated with additional floral and geometric elements. The entire composition is symmetrically balanced with intricate patterns of scrolls, leaves, and ornamental flourishes. The artist's signature and the year 1891 are inscribed in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Gate for Cemetary Plot
